body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal physical Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2; afterward create a temporary low screen in an adjacent empty space until the start of your next turn, with 1 Wound and 0 Resilience.

surges.html: The screen may be placed within 2 units of the target instead.
The target also resists up to 2 units of forced movement from the Action.
